mentions.name: Orchestra
mentions.description: Chat-centered collaboration tool that helps startups and small teams communicate and manage work without bloated, complex software. Built by the author together with two fellow CTOs who couldn't find the right tool.
mentions.problem: Software with too many complex features and integrations drives teams crazy; startups and small teams just need the basics to communicate and manage, and couldn't find a tool that does that simply.
mentions.source_excerpt: on Orchestra, a chat-centered tool that addresses the collaboration gap. it’s when your software drives you crazy with all its complex features and integrations, when all it should really do is help you work. simple as that.
